Title: LR2 - ED-330 - HMI track information content
Text: The DAA HMI shall provide tracks to the RP with, for each track, the following information: - Track ID; - timestamp; - track relative position; - track relative velocity; - track status: coasting or measured; - Track source: ADS_B; Non cooperative; Fused ASD-B + non cooperative (validated); e_conspicuous (ADSL, Flarm); - Flight ID or hexadecimal code for mode S, ADS_B tracks.
